ok so first of all my alarm from rizely didnt go off only my regular alarm went off so i was js like ok thats fine i guess wtv. went on with my day at school. my last class of the day is science and we had extra free time. my teacher made everyone go 
quiet and everyone heard it i didnt know what it was so i was scared until my friend heard it next to her and opened my backpack and said it was my phone. it was. they called the front office and asked what was going on omg that was so embarrassing but other then that it is a good app ig you can say but im probably gonna delete it.

reviews.title: It works
reviews.text: It wakes me up and keeps me awake, I used to be someone who slept through their alarms all the time but I never have yet with Rizely and it actually makes me get up. And it’s free.

reviews.text: It sure does get me up!! It makes me do different stuff to get up even when I don’t want to!
